purpose: Independent verification that the raw Wadhwa .mat matches its pin and that the raw -> derived ingestion chain reproduces the committed artifact.
note: Timestamps are deliberately omitted: this package must be byte-reproducible. Ordering is established by git history.

rederivation.result: Re-derived output is CONTENT-IDENTICAL to the committed experiments/data/wadhwa-2022-events.json (JSON.stringify equality).
rederivation.scriptSelfCheck: scripts/ingest-wadhwa-data.py:90 refuses any raw file whose SHA-256 differs from the pin; it did not raise.

experimentalUnitLedger.note: THREE DISTINCT MOTOR COUNTS EXIST. Conflating them was an error in the earlier Phase A prose and is corrected here.

exclusionCountExplanation.claim: rightCensoredDwells == 109 equals the event-producing motor count for a STRUCTURAL reason, not by coincidence and not by a dwell/motor unit error.
exclusionCountExplanation.conclusion: Exactly one right-censored final dwell per event-producing motor.

uncertainty: Reproduced on one host with numpy 2.3.5 / scipy 1.16.3. scripts/ingest-wadhwa-data.py stamps these versions into the artifact, so a version change would alter it and cascade into every downstream pin.
alternativeExplanation: None: content equality against the committed artifact is exact.
independentlyReproduced: The raw pin was verified by an oracle (PowerShell Get-FileHash) independent of the repository's own scripts, and separately by the script's own guard.
